usage.summary:
Implemented the Go workflow with Gobra contracts and exhaustive explorer, preserving all ratified definitions.

Gate passed on run 2: 1,429 states explored, all witnesses reached, properties held, known bugs caught, contracts proved, and build green.

pins.name: Spec
pins.says: The workflow starts in Init and advances only through Next steps.

pins.name: MergeRequiresCurrentCI
pins.says: The factory merges a follow-up only with passing CI for its current contents.

pins.name: OneFollowup
pins.says: A plan's decision obligation produces at most one follow-up pull request.

pins.name: RepairAllowance
pins.says: The factory uses at most two automatic repairs in each allowance.

pins.name: HumanHoldRespected
pins.says: A follow-up held for closure or exhausted repairs stays closed or blocked until a person explicitly resumes or retries it.

pins.name: TypeOK
pins.says: Every workflow value stays within its declared type.

pins.name: OnlyOwedMergedPlans
pins.says: Decision work starts only after the plan's pull request merges and only if the plan owes a decision.

pins.name: StableFollowupIdentity
pins.says: Creation, repairs, retries and resumption all refer to the same follow-up pull request.

pins.name: DraftUsesEvidence
pins.says: The drafting agent uses the plan, merged change and review as the decision's sources.

pins.name: DecisionClassification
pins.says: The decision is decided by agent exactly when the agent infers that an executed two-way door needs no owner input, and is proposed otherwise.

pins.name: FollowupHasDecision
pins.says: Every created follow-up contains a drafted decision classified as decided or proposed.

pins.name: DecisionCommandUsed
pins.says: The follow-up records its decision by running invariant decisions decide.

pins.name: JournalAndLogAgree
pins.says: The follow-up contains both a journal entry and its log row for the same new decision.

pins.name: CitationsCoverChangedText
pins.says: Every SPEC line and README passage written by the merged change cites the new decision in the follow-up.

pins.name: SpecIsRolledUp
pins.says: The follow-up includes the SPEC roll-up.

pins.name: FollowupScope
pins.says: The follow-up and all its repairs change only decisions/, SPEC.md and the README.

pins.name: MergeWithoutConflict
pins.says: The factory merges a follow-up only when it has no merge conflict.

pins.name: CurrentCIResults
pins.says: A completed CI result always describes the follow-up's current contents.

pins.name: EachRepairStartsFreshCI
pins.says: Every repair consumes one repair from the allowance and starts fresh CI with prior results invalidated.

pins.name: RequestsRenewAllowance
pins.says: Every explicit retry or resume starts with a fresh allowance of two repairs.

pins.name: AllowanceAccounting
pins.says: Only a repair consumes the repair allowance, and only an explicit retry or resume resets it.

pins.name: ExhaustionIsBlocked
pins.says: Work blocked for exhausted repairs has used both repairs and still has failed CI or a merge conflict.

pins.name: DecidedDecisionMerged
pins.says: An executed two-way door inferred to need no owner input can be recorded as decided by agent and merged.

pins.name: OneWayProposedMerged
pins.says: A one-way door can be recorded as proposed and merged.

pins.name: OwnerInputProposedMerged
pins.says: An executed two-way door needing owner input can be recorded as proposed and merged.

pins.name: UnexecutedProposedMerged
pins.says: A two-way door that was not executed can be recorded as proposed and merged.

pins.name: NoDecisionWork
pins.says: A plan can merge without creating a follow-up when it owes no decision.

pins.name: DraftRetried
pins.says: The factory can automatically retry a failed drafting attempt.

pins.name: CreationRetried
pins.says: The factory can automatically retry a failed follow-up creation attempt.

pins.name: RepairCanMerge
pins.says: A repaired follow-up can pass fresh CI and merge.

pins.name: RepairsExhausted
pins.says: A follow-up can exhaust both repairs and block for a person.

pins.name: PersonRenewsExhaustedWork
pins.says: A person can retry an exhausted follow-up with two fresh repairs available.

pins.name: ClosedFollowupWaits
pins.says: A person can close the follow-up and leave its decision obligation waiting for explicit resumption.

pins.name: ResumeRenewsUnusedRepairs
pins.says: Resuming a follow-up closed after one repair can restore two available repairs.

pins.name: ResumeRenewsExhaustedRepairs
pins.says: Resuming a follow-up closed after both repairs can restore two available repairs.

pins.name: DraftProgress
pins.says: An eligible merged plan or a failed drafting attempt eventually starts a drafting attempt.

pins.name: CreationProgress
pins.says: A completed draft or a failed creation attempt eventually starts a follow-up creation attempt.

pins.name: RepairProgress
pins.says: A failed or conflicted follow-up with repairs available eventually receives a repair unless a person closes it.

pins.name: BlockingProgress
pins.says: A failed or conflicted follow-up with no repairs available eventually blocks unless a person closes it.

pins.name: MergeProgress
pins.says: A follow-up ready to merge eventually merges unless a person closes it or a new conflict requires repair.

pins.name: DraftFairness
pins.says: The factory eventually starts a drafting attempt whenever that step remains enabled.

pins.name: CreationFairness
pins.says: The factory eventually starts a creation attempt whenever that step remains enabled.

pins.name: RepairFairness
pins.says: The factory eventually performs an available repair whenever that step remains enabled.

pins.name: BlockingFairness
pins.says: The factory eventually blocks exhausted work whenever that step remains enabled.

pins.name: MergeFairness
pins.says: The factory eventually merges a ready follow-up whenever that step remains enabled.

pins.name: MergeBeforeCI
pins.says: The factory incorrectly merges while the current CI run is still pending.

pins.name: CreateDuplicate
pins.says: The factory incorrectly creates a second follow-up for the same plan.

pins.name: RepairPastAllowance
pins.says: The factory incorrectly makes a third repair without an explicit request.

pins.name: ResumeWithoutPerson
pins.says: The factory incorrectly resumes a closed follow-up without an explicit request.

pins.name: DecideOneWay
pins.says: The drafting agent incorrectly records a one-way door as decided by agent.

usage.summary:
I found four problems in state reporting and parameter coverage.

- **`followup/explore.go:171,190`** invents complete draft sources and bundle contents after success instead of reading implementation output. Missing evidence, citations, or forbidden file changes would be invisible.
- **`followup/explore.go:116`** discards the returned workflow when `ran` is false. A refusal returning changed state would be reported as unchanged.
- **`followup/explore.go:97,101`** resets `RepairLimit` to the explorer constant and never preserves its returned value. This hides a constructor or operation returning the wrong allowance.
- **`.invariant/invariant.json:5`** omits `RepairsPerRequest` from the parameters, although `followup/explore.go:85` passes it to `New(repairLimit)`. This is a configurable limit enforced by the code, so treating it solely as an environment bound leaves the parameter declaration incomplete.

review.text:
I found four problems in state reporting and parameter coverage.

- **`followup/explore.go:171,190`** invents complete draft sources and bundle contents after success instead of reading implementation output. Missing evidence, citations, or forbidden file changes would be invisible.
- **`followup/explore.go:116`** discards the returned workflow when `ran` is false. A refusal returning changed state would be reported as unchanged.
- **`followup/explore.go:97,101`** resets `RepairLimit` to the explorer constant and never preserves its returned value. This hides a constructor or operation returning the wrong allowance.
- **`.invariant/invariant.json:5`** omits `RepairsPerRequest` from the parameters, although `followup/explore.go:85` passes it to `New(repairLimit)`. This is a configurable limit enforced by the code, so treating it solely as an environment bound leaves the parameter declaration incomplete.
